description: Source file implementing local notification handling for a Flutter app, including initialization, displaying notifications with actions, payload encoding/decoding, and response handling for notification taps and actions.

classes.name: LocalNotifications
classes.description: Helper class managing local notifications, including initialization, showing notifications with actions, and response handling within the app.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the notification plugin, sets up channels and categories, requests permissions, and checks if notifications are enabled, to be called once during app startup.

methods.name: showSavedArticleNotification
methods.description: Displays a notification indicating that an article has been saved, with actions to open the saved articles screen or undo the save.

methods.name: _toPayloadJson
methods.description: Converts a NewsArticle object into a JSON-compatible Map for inclusion in notification payloads.

methods.name: _articleFromPayload
methods.description: Reconstructs a NewsArticle object from a JSON payload string decoded from a notification response.

methods.name: _handleAction
methods.description: Handles user actions from the notification, such as opening the saved articles screen or undoing a save.

methods.name: _onDidReceiveNotificationResponse
methods.description: Callback triggered when a notification response is received, delegates to _handleAction.

methods.name: _onDidReceiveBackgroundNotificationResponse
methods.description: Background callback for notification responses, processes actions like undo save.
